name: Shoko Relay
overview: A custom metadata provider and automation toolset for integrating Plex and AnimeThemes with Shoko Server.

releases.release_notes:
A breaking abstractions change (just like yesterday) with the same "lightly tested" statement from the previous release still applying.

**Note:**
- Force refreshing the dashboard (`Ctrl-F5`) is required for all of the front end changes to take effect

**Changes:**
- Added a "Remember Me" option (30-day persistent vs. browser-session cookie) to the login modal along with a conditional Logout button and `POST /auth/logout` endpoint when `RequireAuth` is enabled
- Renamed task log endpoints (`/logs/*` → `/reports/*`), `RelayResponse.ReportUrl`, and dashboard UI/CSS identifiers from "Logs" to "Reports" across the API, dashboard, and documentation
- Included TMDB movie tags (`IMovie`) in tag filtering, global cache warming, and CSV tag reports, and fixed TMDB rating fallbacks for standalone movies when a linked movie has no rating
- Guarded `PurgeMissingFiles` against unmounted empty mount points using `IFileSystem.IsDirectoryEmpty`
- Improved cross-platform VFS symlink safety (Windows directory symlinks, real-directory collisions, atomic writes, and deferred symlink `Stat` evaluation in `VfsIgnoreRule`)
- Filtered ignored subdirectories during recursive AnimeThemes MP3 audits and cached per-directory artwork lookups during Plex image sync
- Fixed stale VFS folders when replacing TMDB links on auto-merged series, fixed DST transition collisions when scheduling daily action triggers, and prevented `HttpContext` / `ExecutionContext` leaks into background tasks
- Polished modal footer/cancel button styling, shared styled checkboxes across dashboard/browser/player pages, and deduplicated shared helpers across Plex, Sync, Config, VFS, and Dashboard modules
- Updated `Docs/CONTROLLER.md`, `README.md`, and dashboard help text
- Bumped Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.143

**Contributions:**
* @revam in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/25

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.23.0...v0.24.0

This release is a lightly tested version of what was intended to be Shoko Relay's v1.0.0 RC1. Due to breaking Shoko.Abstractions changes in the past day, it has been released earlier than anticipated. So I would encourage users to try out all of the new (and old) features and report any issues that they find on Discord.

**Notes:**
- Force refreshing the dashboard (`Ctrl-F5`) is required for all of the front end changes to take effect
- If you use the favourites feature in the AnimeThemes Player, `favs_animethemes.cache` in the configuration folder must be renamed to `favs_animethemes.csv`
- All other `.cache` files have been moved to Shoko's dedicated plugin cache directory
  - Any legacy `.cache` files left in the configuration folder can be safely deleted along with the now defunct `/logs` subdirectory

**Highlights:**
- Optional dashboard authentication with an "Allow Player Access" mode for sharing the AnimeThemes Player without granting admin access
- Multi-user watched-state, progress, and rating syncing (supporting both Plex Home users and shared server friends) mapped to individual Shoko users
- Shoko WebUI series links that navigate directly to the matching series branch in the VFS Browser
- A new AnimeThemes Downloader modal for easily fetching recent or seasonal themes not yet in the torrent archive
- Cross-root AnimeThemes `.webm` support for collections split across multiple managed folders or storage drives

---

**Changes:**
- Added opt-in administrator authentication (`Require Authentication`) using Shoko username/password login, including an `Allow Player Access` mode for sharing the standalone AnimeThemes Player
- Added multi-user watched sync and webhook support for Plex Home users and shared server friends, plus `Advanced User Mappings` with optional PINs
- Added the **AnimeThemes Downloader** modal on the dashboard for downloading themes by name filter (up to 10 themes), current season, or recently added releases
- Added `AnimeThemes Transfer Mode` (`Hardlink (Copy Fallback)`, `Move`, `Do Nothing`) to automatically share or relocate `.webm` themes when series reside in a different managed folder
- Added native Shoko executable actions (with progress reporting) for global VFS, AnimeThemes, and watched-sync tasks as well as per-series VFS rebuilds and Plex refreshes
- Added `VFS Browser` external links directly on series in Shoko's WebUI with automatic deep-linking to the matching series in the browser tree
- Added diagnostic CSV reports (`/reports/tags` and `/reports/credits`) to inspect how tags, genres, cast, crew, and studios are filtered and merged across your library
- Added collapsible `Metadata`, `Language`, and `Advanced` sections in Provider Settings with persisted open/closed states
- Added a title refresh button to the VFS Browser and scroll-wheel volume controls to the AnimeThemes Player
- Improved Shoko title and description language priority handling and added automatic VFS updates when preferred TMDB orderings or hidden episode states change
- Improved Windows long-path compatibility and reduced unnecessary Shoko file-watcher activity across VFS, AnimeThemes, and housekeeping operations
- Moved rebuildable `.cache` and task `.report` files into Shoko's dedicated plugin cache directory, keeping the configuration folder clean
- Improved reverse-proxy URL detection and Shoko WebUI theme variable mapping across dashboard pages
- Improved partial progress, rating clear (`unrate`), and multi-library handling during Plex/Shoko watched syncing and webhooks
- Preserved custom VFS override coordinates over TMDB episode groupings, cleaned up stale movie VFS folders automatically, and improved local artwork linking across override groups
- Saved partial `Theme.mp3` caches and reports when batch generation is cancelled, and improved AnimeThemes API rate-limit handling and download cleanup
- Fixed numerous edge cases across metadata matching, multi-episode movie handling, collection artwork uploads, VFS path exclusions, and dashboard UI controls
- Bumped Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.141

**Contributions:**
* @revam in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/24

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.22.0...v0.23.0

Technically the largest set of changes ever for this repository, the goal of this version is to be ready for the rapidly approaching Shoko v6.0.0 stable. This includes: some decent performance gains, bugfixes, hardening/safety checks and the inclusion of external csv files into the main repository.

**Notes:**
- Force refreshing the dashboard (`Ctrl-F5`) may be required for all of the front end changes to take effect
- For those who use them the "Tag Blacklist" (now under "Tag Overrides") and "Tag Sources" settings will also need to be reconfigured

**Changes:**
- Migrated AnimeThemes integration from the legacy REST API (soon to be deprecated) to their new GraphQL API
- Added automatic and manual backfilling for missing AniDB IDs and metadata on existing AnimeThemes WebM files without redownloading
- Improved AnimeThemes slug detection, added cleanup for failed WebM downloads, and made batch MP3 generation automatically play the first downloaded theme when the miniplayer is enabled
- Changed Tag Sources to a multiselect dropdown supporting any combination of AniDB, TMDB, User, or no tags while migrating existing configurations automatically
- Replaced Tag Blacklist with Tag Overrides to support custom merges and blacklists, and moved default tag and studio/credit overrides into built-in CSV files
- Fixed global deduplication for genres, studios, cast, and crew so plurals, punctuation, and naming stay consistent across all series
- Added Company Listings to include studios and production companies in Cast and Crew with TMDB logo support while excluding broadcast networks
- Added the "Spoof AniDB Ratings" option to display AniDB ratings using the Rotten Tomatoes audience rating icon
- Added Collection Exclusions to protect third-party Plex collections from item removal or automatic deletion, and enforced exact title matching when finding collections
- Improved movie metadata support for films in TV libraries as well as multi-episode movie files stored in a single video file
- Prevented previously synced Plex thumbnails from appearing in metadata responses when TMDB Thumbnails is enabled
- Fixed metadata provider caching so provider settings changes take effect immediately
- Improved startup speed when Auto Merge TMDB Series is enabled and sped up AnimeThemes video player tree loading
- Fixed missing individual sub-task report logs when running full Plex automation and fixed missing direction labels in scheduled watch sync logs
- Added extra safety checks for Plex trash emptying, VFS folder cleanup, IPv6 server URLs, and case-insensitive local extra filenames
- Included the curated VFS overrides and AnimeThemes mapping files directly in the repository instead of external gists
- Polished the narrow dashboard header layout, added a resizable Tag Overrides input, and updated help docs
- Bumped Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.130

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.5...v0.22.0

For this release force refreshing the dashboard (`Ctrl-F5`) may be required for all of the front end changes to take effect.
Shout-out to kifujin/preeefix for making me aware of the extra-only series and dynamic Plex server URL issues respectively.

**Changes:**
- Introduced an advanced custom episode mapping system to VFS Overrides, allowing specific episodes, ranges, and types to be mapped to custom season and episode coordinates.
- Added support for applying custom episode mappings to standalone series without needing to merge multiple AniDB IDs.
- Added a "Plex Server URL" advanced setting to manually override auto-discovered Plex connection addresses, resolving connectivity issues in dynamic environments (#23).
- Improved managed user token resolution to reliably match Plex server identities across custom hostnames and reverse proxies.
- Implemented a fallback rule for extra-only series to promote Credits, Trailers, or Parodies to Season 1, ensuring series without regular episodes are properly indexed by Plex.
- Fixed the "Other" episode fallback rule to correctly identify empty seasons when dealing with discarded crossover episodes and joined multi-episode files.
- Enhanced the Plex Discovery task report to display resolved server URLs, active connection overrides, the configured metadata agent, and physical folder paths.
- Fixed a boundary validation regression that prevented source symlink mapping when using drive root mounts.
- Updated the README and API documentation to reflect the new custom mapping syntax, endpoints, and fallback behaviors.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.4...v0.21.5

**Changes:**
- Fall back to TMDB content ratings when AssumedContentRatings is disabled or when no assumed rating tags match
- Add TmdbSeries and IsAdult to SeriesContext to eliminate redundant database queries and parental rating checks
- Update MapSeries and MapEpisode to accept SeriesContext directly, aligning with MapSeason
- Exclude 1-hour frequency from generating 24 daily triggers in ActionScheduleHelper.cs and fall back to a single hourly interval trigger
- Patch path traversal in Log/WebM endpoints and SourceLinkService
- Bump Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.125
- Minor README/Controller.md tweaks

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.3...v0.21.4

This release is a general optimisation pass with some improvements across the board for VFS builds and metadata lookups. The most significant improvement affects series that have alternate episode orderings assigned to them (which were incorrectly querying Shoko's database multiple times per episode causing massive performance degradation).

**Changes:**
- Massively improved metadata provider response times and eliminated potential thread pool starvation during large library scans
- Added an in-memory series context cache with automatic invalidation during VFS updates and scheduled metadata fixups
- Drastically sped up alternate TMDB episode group resolution by replacing repeated database queries with pre-indexed lookups
- Optimized cast and crew deduplication by replacing linear name scans and runtime string splitting with indexed lookups
- Accelerated VFS generation by linking series-level metadata once per folder and skipping redundant disk checks on clean builds
- Slightly sped up VFS Browser and AnimeThemes Player loading by caching tree data, batching disk checks, and implementing lazy UI rendering
- Bumped Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.120

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.2...v0.21.3

**Changes:**
- Updated PlexMetadataItem to include Media and Part properties to support physical file path extraction
- Added GetFallbackLibraryTargetAsync to PlexClient to allow querying Plex for libraries not using the Shoko Relay provider
- Updated SyncToShoko to intercept specific library filters and engage a legacy fallback mode if the library is not a recognized Relay target
- Implemented filename-based matching fallback within SyncToShoko to map Plex's physical paths against Shoko's VideoFiles
- Added missing diagnostic logging for the admin user fetch in SyncHelper.cs to ensure transparency for all processed users
- Updated README/Controller.md to document the fallback migration feature
- Bumped Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.115

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.1...v0.21.2

Further fixes related to Plex Server changes from [CVE-2026-96655](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9x88-w2p7-56vh)

**Changes:**
- Modified the image upload method in PlexCollections.cs to utilise direct file stream uploads preventing DNS/networking errors on restricted networks
- Updated CollectionService.cs to supply raw file paths to the Plex API and remove the legacy NormalizeCacheUrl helper
- Added hidden RequireSubtitleLanguageCodes advanced setting

**Contributions:**
* @Foowy in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/21

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.21.0...v0.21.1

A small but breaking change has been made in the abstractions which should help to enhance cast deduplication performance.

**Changes:**
- Enhance FindMatchingTmdbEntry to compare whitespace-stripped AniDB OriginalName values against whitespace-stripped TMDB OriginalName and TMDB AlternativeNames as high-priority fast paths
- Remove the AniDB `AlternativeNames` check, as Shoko doesn't populate alternate names for AniDB creators
- Implement a 5th pass in `FindMatchingTmdbEntry` to compare AniDB's romanised Name (and its flipped variant) against TMDB AlternativeNames (and their flipped variants) to ensure accurate fallback matching
- Read a creator's and a character's name from `Title`, their original name from `OriginalTitle` and their other names from `Titles`, now that `Name`, `OriginalName` and `AlternativeNames` are gone
- Implement case-insensitive, whitespace-ignoring deduplication for studio tags via `DistinctBy` in `GetStudioTags`
- Bump Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.108


**Contributions:**
* @revam in https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/pull/20

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.20.2...v0.21.0
